verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a headless-capable install (ROS-Base 'Bare Bones' with no GUI tools) plus a full CLI toolset (ros2 command, topic pub, bag record/play) that can be scripted for automation, supporting non-interactive/CI-style operation. However there's no explicit documentation of CI pipelines, Docker images, or automated test harnesses for ROS 2 itself. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation docs or examples, containerized/headless deployment guidance, and independent evidence of running ROS 2 in a CI pipeline.
